svg.title: Orders
svg.desc: Nodes: Shop web app (client); Orders API (service, ok); Orders DB (database); Order events (queue); Ledger (service). Edges: Shop web app calls Orders API over graphql at 30/s: Places orders. Orders API calls Orders DB over postgres. Orders API sends messages to Order events: Announces orders. Order events sends messages to Ledger over amqp: Posts entries.
